exposure: Nursing intervention based on routine nursing
outcome: Postpartum amount of bleeding within 2 hours
Postpartum amount of bleeding within 24 hours
cohort: The study included expectant primiparae hospitalized in the study hospital between February 2012 and February 2013, randomly divided into an intervention group and a control group.
finding: The nursing intervention significantly reduced the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage and improved postpartum satisfaction compared to routine nursing.
mod_finding: The nursing intervention significantly reduced the cesarean rate (7.14% in the intervention group vs. 16.07% in the control group, interpreting the likely intent despite a typo in the original abstract).
